learning_outcomes.text: The students understand the basic idea of sustainable development and its future necessity.
The students know the global development goals (SDGs) and can evaluate their own behavior, existing technologies, and potential inventions within this framework.
The students specifically know the 'Life Cycle Assessment' procedure and the idea of 'Cradle to Cradle' in this regard.
The students know the requirements of scientific work.
The students are enabled to work scientifically independently, especially research, library, and literature work.
The students know and can apply the rules for writing student papers and quality criteria for scientific work.
The students are enabled to work independently.
The students practice partner and teamwork in the exercises.
The students can explain and present the solutions they independently achieved in the exercises to the group.
The students learn to work independently.
Through exercises, the students learn independent, problem-oriented, and action-oriented work.

syllabus_topics: Concepts and definitions of sustainability and sustainable development
Digital transformation and ethical and sustainable aspects
teaching_methods: Seminar-style instruction with group and partner work
